blurb: Dirty Water Distillery is a micro-distillery located in Historic Cordage Park, Plymouth, MA, producing artisanal liquors including flavored vodkas, gins, rum, liqueurs, and whiskey. They operate a taproom serving craft beers brewed in-house and tap-cocktails made with their spirits, with food delivery partnerships.
extraNote: Minimum 3 hour rental for event spaces · Outside catering must be approved by DW events team · No tacks on walls, glitter, confetti, or open flame candles allowed for decorations · DW is a smoke free property including vaping, cigars, cigarettes
